facts.text: SingleAgentRaceEnv is the single-agent Gymnasium environment of the gym API
A scenario that lists no actuators gets the VehicleSpec default ['steering', 'motor']
The vehicle action space is a Dict keyed by actuator name
The motor actuator's action space is Box(low=-1.0, high=1.0, shape=(1,))
The steering actuator's action space is Box(low=-1.0, high=1.0, shape=(1,))
The car's action space is normalized between -1 and 1
The vehicle observation space is a Dict keyed by sensor name
The single-agent observation space adds a 'time' Box with declared bounds 0 to 1 to the agent's sensor Dict
The step writes the growing simulation time into observation['time'] without clipping it to the declared Box bound
The shipped austria scenario requests the lidar, pose, velocity and acceleration sensors
The racecar lidar is configured with 1080 rays, range 15.0 and min_range 0.25
The lidar space is a Box of one value per ray bounded by min_range and min_range+range
A world update advances pybullet by one simulation step and adds the configured time step to the state time
The SimulationSpec time step defaults to 0.01 s
The fixed-timestep sensor scheduler is constructed with a 0.01 s time step
The single-agent reset passes the seed to gymnasium.Env.reset
Sensor noise is drawn from numpy's global generator (np.random.normal), so the seed passed to gymnasium.Env.reset does not control it
The reset option 'mode' selects the starting-position mode and defaults to 'grid'
The maximize_progress task's default progress_reward is 100.0
The maximize_progress reward is the change in lap+progress times progress_reward
The maximize_progress task ends when lap > laps or time > time_limit
The single-agent registration passes the scenario path as the scenario kwarg
The gym_api module registers one SingleAgent<Track>-v0 environment per scenario file
SingleAgentAustria-v0 is documented as a predefined environment id

determinism.notes: SingleAgentRaceEnv.reset(seed) seeds gymnasium's own np_random, but the sensor models draw their noise from numpy's global generator (racecar_gym/bullet/sensors.py:255), so one seed does not fix a trajectory; the package fake uses its own seeded random.Random.

gaps: the fake backend is a kinematic stand-in, not the pybullet model: it has no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, collisions, opponents, laps, ranks or task termination; its pose, velocity, acceleration, progress and reward are placeholders
the fake returns a constant placeholder lidar scan of the real 1080-ray length and does not model the pose, velocity or acceleration sensor noise, the camera or the sensor frequencies

the physics time step is read from the downloaded track scene's simulation.time_step (racecar_gym/bullet/providers.py:110), which is not in the clone; the contract states the 0.01 s SimulationSpec default (racecar_gym/core/specs.py:8) and the fixed 0.01 s sensor scheduler (racecar_gym/bullet/providers.py:67), and the fake advances 0.01 s per transition as a placeholder
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0 and ticks advance simulated time only
snapshot and restore are not offered: SingleAgentRaceEnv exposes no get_state/set_state (only MultiAgentRaceEnv has set_state)
the track scene files under models/scenes are downloaded on first use and are not in the clone; neither the fake nor this package loads them
the fake's observation 'time' is a one-element array while upstream writes a 0-d float32 array, and the fake never terminates an episode while the shipped task ends at lap > laps or time > time_limit
no physical device is modelled and nothing was validated against one

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: the runtime latch refuses every step and reset after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears it, and the last state stays readable; the simulator has no native stop
